title: STANLEY DRUCKENMILLER'S DUQUESNE JUST UPDATED ITS STOCK PORTFOLIO
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Druckenmiller remodeled the book. He added 180.16% to Seagate (STX),  
now a $315M No. 2 position behind a still-huge $1.31B stake in Natera  
(NTRA), boosted Amazon (AMZN) by 42.65%, and more than quintupled  
Unity (U). He also opened gold-miner lines in Newmont (NEM), Barrick  
(B) and Agnico Eagle (AEM), plus new Western Digital (WDC), SpaceX  
(SPCX) and Palantir (PLTR). What he left behind: TSMC (TSM) was cut  
94.45%, and he sold out of Alphabet (GOOGL), AMD (AMD), SanDisk  
(SNDK), United Airlines (UAL) and Delta (DAL).  
  
Here are the top holdings as of the end of Q3:  
  
\- $1.31B of Natera (NTRA)  
\- $315M of Seagate (STX) (added 180.16%)  
\- $193M of Amazon (AMZN) (added 42.65%)  
\- $191M of Fox (FOXA) (added 38.17%)  
\- $178M of YPF (YPF) (added 12.84%)  
\- $162M of Unity (U) (added 435.53%)  
\- $155M of Sea (SE) (added 44.81%)  
\- $126M of iShares MSCI Brazil ETF (EWZ)  
\- $125M of Insmed (INSM) (cut 23.31%)  
\- $90M of Revolution Medicines (RVMD) (added 9.18%)  
\- $87M of BBB Foods (TBBB) (cut 43.23%)  
\- $86M of STMicroelectronics (STM) (cut 47.94%)  
\- $82M of NewAmsterdam Pharma (NAMS) (added 9.35%)  
\- $74M of CDW (CDW) (cut 22.61%)  
\- $62M of Somnigroup (SGI) (new)  
\- $44M of Newmont (NEM) (new)  
\- $43M of Barrick (B) (new)  
\- $42M of Agnico Eagle (AEM) (new)  
\- $40M of Bitdeer (BTDR) (cut 7.20%)  
\- $37M of Coupang (CPNG)  
\- $37M of Western Digital (WDC) (new)  
\- $36M of Hyperliquid Strategies (PURR)  
\- $36M of Fox (FOX)  
\- $35M of Fluor (FLR) (cut 26.39%)  
\- $32M of AppLovin (APP) (new)  
  
Also: $31M of SpaceX (SPCX) (new), $15M of Palantir (PLTR) (new), and  
$15M of TSMC (TSM) (cut 94.45%).  
  
Sold out: Alphabet (GOOGL), United Airlines (UAL), SanDisk (SNDK),  
Delta (DAL), D.R. Horton (DHI), AMD (AMD)  
  
Holdings are as of September 30, per Duquesne's Q3 13F filing. 13Fs  
only cover long U.S.-listed positions and lag the market, so the fund  
may have changed these since then. Figures above are common-stock  
positions; the filing also included about $322M in call options, led  
by Amazon and Seagate. Equity holdings totaled $4.15B ($4.47B  
including options).  
  
This looks like one of the bigger overhauls of the quarter. What do  
you make of the gold-miner and storage adds versus the near-exit from  
TSMC?
